description: Below (1,0) in lexicographically ordered natural pairs lies exactly the infinite first row {(0,n)}; this order is not isomorphic to the usual natural-number order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.lex_predecessors :
  (Set.Iio (toLex (1, 0)) = Set.range fun n => toLex (0, n)) ∧
    (Set.Iio (toLex (1, 0))).Infinite ∧ ¬Nonempty (Lex (ℕ × ℕ) ≃o ℕ)
